objective: Remove the build-time network dependency: app/layout.tsx loads JetBrains Mono through next/font/google, so npm run build fails without internet (the Codex review sandbox and any offline CI). Self-host the font with next/font/local so the build is hermetic, with no visible change to the site.
acceptanceCriteria: app/layout.tsx uses next/font/local with JetBrains Mono font files committed under the app (only the weights and styles the site actually uses, woff2, latin subset where available), exposing the same --font-mono CSS variable and font-mono class so no other file needs to change.
The font files' source, version, OFL license and the exact weights shipped are recorded in ASSETS.md, with the license file included next to the fonts.

npm run build exits 0 with network access disabled (prove it by running the build in a copy of the tree with outbound network blocked, for example a sandbox or an unresolvable proxy, and record the exit code); the / route First Load JS and the total font bytes transferred for / are recorded before and after.

Rendered text is visually identical: screenshots of the hero and one content section before and after, at the same viewport, compared with a pixel diff that shows no change in glyph shapes (antialiasing noise only), and no flash of unstyled text on load.

npm run lint, npm test and npm run build (online) exit 0 with exit codes captured; only app/layout.tsx, the font files and license, and ASSETS.md change; new content has no em dash or machine-local path; no commit is made.
constraints: Work only inside the isolated worktree path supplied in the delegation prompt; do not commit; never run git stash, reset or checkout.

A game-dev stage runs in parallel in the same worktree and owns components/game/*, components/avatar/TalkingAvatar.tsx, app/page.tsx and components/site/Nav.tsx; do not edit those. If app/layout.tsx is on the design.md section 9 do-not-touch list, stop and report blocked instead of editing it.
Pinned sources only: either commit woff2 files from the official JetBrains Mono release or copy them from an exactly pinned @fontsource/jetbrains-mono devDependency; record which.
Run the production build in a copy of the tree so the dev server's .next is not clobbered.
Copy every acceptanceCriteria string verbatim into the report criteria array.
